original.quote: The aggregate liability of each party shall not exceed the fees paid in the prior twelve (12) months. This limitation is the sole and exhaustive cap on liability under this SOW.

redline.proposed_text: The total aggregate liability of each party under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Buyer to the Supplier in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
redline.rationale: Amended to match the fallback position for liability caps to ensure clarity on the twelve-month preceding period.

original.quote: The Supplier shall indemnify the Buyer for third-party claims arising from the Services, subject to the limitation of liability in Clause 5, except that indemnities for data breach shall remain uncapped.

redline.proposed_text: The Supplier's indemnification obligations under this Clause shall be subject to a separate aggregate cap not exceeding two (2) times the annual fees, save that indemnities for intellectual property infringement and data breach shall remain uncapped.
redline.rationale: Updated indemnity terms to include a separate aggregate cap of two times annual fees in accordance with the playbook fallback.

original.quote: The Supplier shall meet a measurable service level of 98% scheduled-task completion per month. Service credits of 2% of the monthly fee apply per percentage point missed, capped at 10% of the monthly fee.

redline.proposed_text: The Supplier shall meet a measurable service level of at least 99.9% platform availability per calendar month, with service credits of 5% of the monthly fee per percentage point missed, capped at 20% of the monthly fee.
redline.rationale: Replaced the SLA terms with the required platform availability and service credit fallback standards.

original.quote: The Supplier may freely assign, novate or subcontract this SOW, in whole or in part, to any third party without the prior consent of the Buyer.

redline.proposed_text: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other, save that either party may assign to an affiliate on written notice.
redline.rationale: Restricted free assignment to require consent or allow affiliate assignment on notice per ASSIGN-001 fallback.
